title: Formula record extension v1 (additive verification, external context and crosswalk)
description: A sidecar for formula-record/1. It never changes the published record: it carries verification states from math-trace, pointer-only external context (for example a Stacks tag), and a review pin. A record without this file remains valid.

record_id.description: The slug of the formula record this sidecar extends.

record_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the full record. Detects drift between record and extension.

math_trace_id.description: The producer-side formula key, for example math-trace/michaelis_menten. Optional when the slug is enough.

expr_hash.description: The canonical SymPy expression hash from math-trace when the base record does not carry one yet.

holds.description: math-trace's residual check. null means not exported.

statuses.description: Independent statuses; an absent status is unverified, never false.

external.description: Pointer-only context. Nothing here is fetched at read time; snapshots carry their own sha256 and licence status.

id.description: For stacks: the tag, for example 0ELT.

url.description: Canonical upstream URL of the snapshot, not a fetch-on-read instruction.
